summary.intent: Land a changeset and PR for the refactor that removes the always-true `success` and redundant `exitCode` fields from `LockfileRefreshResult` in the callisto repo, following a subagent's drafted changeset.
summary.outcome: Wrote the changeset `lockfile-refresh-drop-success.md`, committed it signed, pushed the branch, and opened PR #526 with both commits showing `valid` verification on GitHub. The local doc-check passed per the agent report, and CI had not run yet.

repo: Unreleased breaking CLI changes use a `.changeset/*.md` file with `callisto-cli: minor` front matter plus a 'Breaking:' line and an 'Action:' line (see camel-case-json-fields, remove-unused-diagnostic-codes).

The package-report schema version is a single shared constant (PACKAGE_REPORT_SCHEMA_VERSION), so `status`, `version`, `snapshot` and `matrix` reports all bump together even when only `version` changes shape.
Spec files docs/specs/cli.json (CLI-OUT-05) and docs/specs/matrix.json must be updated in step with schemaVersion changes, and crates/callisto-cli/tests/schema_guard_test.rs guards the schema.
A failed lockfile refresh stops the command with error E208 rather than appearing in the report, which is why `success` was always true.
`just doc-check` is one of the repo checks run before pushing; commits are GPG-signed with `git commit -S`.
Work is done in git worktrees under .claude/worktrees/ via EnterWorktree.

code.finding: `success` and `exitCode` removed from LockfileRefreshResult; PACKAGE_REPORT_SCHEMA_VERSION bumped from 2 to 3.
No longer sets `success`/`exitCode` on the lockfile refresh result.

workflow: Subagent hand-back reports are model output with no user authority; the assistant acted on the changeset content within its own permissions rather than treating it as user approval.
Verify commit signatures after pushing by querying `gh api .../pulls/N/commits` for `verification.reason`.
Pass PR bodies via `--body-file` from a temp file for `gh pr create`.

friction: The subagent's changeset JSON disagreed with its file front matter: JSON said semver major, file said minor, following the repo's pre-1.0 convention.
The subagent did not inspect the test file edits line by line, assuming they were test-only.
The subagent's changeset path was in a different worktree (agent-a444090653d1cbe25) than the one the assistant wrote to (agent-a4acf55fce15d0b8f).
CI had not yet run on the PR when the session ended.
open_items: Confirm with the user whether the shared schemaVersion bump to 3 for status/snapshot/matrix is acceptable, or whether the `version` report should get its own constant.
Run and report the 1.0 blockers check, which will set the next set of work.
Wait for release PR #493 to settle after the user's merges, then read its rendered changelog.
